entries.descriptionOriginal: VIP Revamped | Forgotten Classic with a Fresh Touch Protect the VIP, or be one of them trying to escape while Ts hunt them down! Best for playing 3v3, 4v4, 5v5 and more! Game mode rules Rescue Zone: The rescue helicopter arrives at random place Buy Zone: VIPs can't access buy menu VIP Loadout: VIPs have 150 HP, heavy armor, and a limited loadout: a Five-SeveN, a Taser, and a medi-shot with some nades. Vulnerability: VIPs take double damage from Molotovs/Incendiary Grenades! Be careful, mate! Weapon Restrictions: Unlike the original Assassination from CS1.6, no weapons are restricted for CTs or Ts! Feel free to use the full arsenal. T Win Condition: Killing all VIPs ends the round, resulting in a T victory. CT Win Condition: Rescuing the VIP ends the round, resulting in a CT victory. Known issues If you are close to the VIP you might be not able to pick up some weapons Bots are not controllable to prevent some issues. Enabling bot controlling can break scripts
